current_normalization: standard minimal charged current, Thomson-subtracted VP; alpha(0) selected independently
excluded_overlap: 4d internal hadronic radiation already in inclusive R; no pureleptonic term repeated
native_scope: matched minimal current hadronic two-current NLO projection only; no full BHSM native form assertion
uncertainty_scope: source range/point covariance propagated coherently and linearly; refinement estimates, no rigorous full-QCD remainder enclosure
